name: Similarity Search
description: Search similar vectors for a query text using a connected embedding source and vector store controller.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Query text to embed and search against the vector store.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Top-k retrieval hits with score and optional metadata.

controllers.name: embedding
controllers.description: Embedding controller from TEXT_EMBEDDING to ensure query embedding uses the same provider/model.

controllers.name: store
controllers.description: Connected vector store handle used as the retrieval source.

parameters.name: similarity_strategy
parameters.description: Similarity metric used by search. Must match the vector store metric.

parameters.name: ann_search_depth
parameters.description: ANN search depth (for example ef_search-style controls). Higher improves recall but increases latency.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of top matches to return.

parameters.name: score_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum normalized similarity score to keep a result.

parameters.name: include_metadata
parameters.description: Include hit metadata in retrieval output.
